name: Nortriptyline
effects: Active metabolite of amitriptyline — reduces depressive symptoms
Better tolerated than amitriptyline (less sedating, less anticholinergic)
Used for neuropathic pain, smoking cessation adjunct
Therapeutic drug monitoring recommended (target serum 50–150 ng/mL)
Anticholinergic effects, orthostatic hypotension, QTc prolongation
